name: agent-files
about: What an agent reads on a Pages site (herdos public-site rules 6 and 7): a markdown twin of every page, built after the site's build and served on Accept: text/markdown; the agent card's /a2a endpoint, which refuses plainly until the site has chat; and a read-only MCP at /mcp that lists the sitemap's pages and returns one page's twin. Public pages only, no auth, no writes. The site writes its own agent-card.json and mcp.json, with the MCP server card, api-catalog, skills index, ard.json and ai-catalog.json, through site-templates' discovery.py (site-kit#314).
